gouki_no_kutsu.evidence: 2010 Japanese name uses 剛鬼; 2013 uses 鬼. The sets do not coexist in either catalog. Corresponding English names, type, INCREASE_ATK/DFS effect, attack bonus and price match; helm defense changes 6 to 7 and gauntlet 6 to 5. This is replacement artwork for corresponding cards, not proof of identical historical drawings.
